hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that enables 1:1 swapping between ETH and phiEth (an ETH wrapper) by intercepting swaps, taking the input, depositing/withdrawing via the phiEth contract, and settling the output directly — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity additions are blocked and only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee are permitted.
